Pokémon: Eevee & Evolutions

Pokémon Fun Facts!

Eevee is known for its many possible evolutions, called "Eeveelutions"!
Eevee can evolve into 8 different Pokémon, each with a unique type!
Eevee is a Normal-type Pokémon, but its evolutions cover Water, Fire, Electric, Psychic, Dark, Grass, Ice, and Fairy types!

Eevee

The Evolution Pokémon. Cute, adaptable, and full of surprises!

Vaporeon

Water-type. Evolves from Eevee with a Water Stone.

Jolteon

Electric-type. Evolves from Eevee with a Thunder Stone.

Flareon

Fire-type. Evolves from Eevee with a Fire Stone.

Espeon

Psychic-type. Evolves from Eevee with high friendship during the day.

Umbreon

Dark-type. Evolves from Eevee with high friendship during the night.

Leafeon

Grass-type. Evolves from Eevee near a Moss Rock or with a Leaf Stone.

Glaceon

Ice-type. Evolves from Eevee near an Ice Rock or with an Ice Stone.

Sylveon

Fairy-type. Evolves from Eevee when it knows a Fairy-type move and has high friendship.

Meiza

The Pokemon master of this magical team!

Pokémon Legends: Arceus

Alpha Pokémon Fun Facts!

In Pokémon Legends: Arceus, the red-eyed wild Pokémon are called Alpha Pokémon.
Alpha Pokémon are bigger, stronger, and usually much higher level than nearby wild Pokémon.
When they notice the player, they often chase and attack right away!

Why this page is special

This section is for kids who love Pokémon Legends: Arceus and especially the scary-cool red-eyed Alpha Pokémon. The pictures below load from the internet, so classmates can open the page and see them directly.

Dr. STONE Series

Science Fun Facts!

Senku wants to rebuild the whole world using science!
The story mixes survival, teamwork, and amazing inventions.
Characters make useful things like soap, glass, and medicine!
Science can solve almost any problem step by step!

Why kids may love Dr. STONE

It is full of experiments, teamwork, and cool inventions. Perfect for kids who like building and discovering things!

Adventure in a brand new stone world!

Science helps rebuild civilization!

Friends work together to solve problems!

Every invention starts with an idea!

  • Village Discovery

Senku

Godzilla Movie Series

Godzilla Fun Facts!

Godzilla first appeared in 1954 and has starred in dozens of movies!
This page uses online images, so classmates can open the HTML and see the posters directly.
The movies are grouped by different eras, from classic black-and-white monster stories to modern giant battles.

All Godzilla movies in one place

Tap a card to open the Wikipedia page for that movie. Posters are loaded from the web automatically, so you do not need to keep image files on your computer.

Godzilla Film Collection

Wings of Fire Series

Dragon Fun Facts!

There are 7 different dragon tribes with unique abilities!
Each tribe has special powers like fire-breathing, ice breath, or mind-reading!
The story spans two continents: Pyrrhia and Pantala!
Dragonets can become queens and kings of their tribes!
Some dragons can see the future or read minds!

Prophecy: The Dragonets

  • Five dragonets are chosen to end the SandWing war.
  • Clay, Tsunami, Glory, Starflight, and Sunny are raised in secret.
  • The prophecy pushes them toward destiny, but they learn to choose their own path.

Prophecy: Jade Mountain

  • A new school brings young dragons from different tribes together.
  • Moonwatcher hears thoughts and sees flashes of dangerous futures.
  • The prophecy warns that trust, friendship, and courage matter more than fear.

Prophecy: The Lost Continent

  • Dragons discover Pantala and a hidden history across the sea.
  • Blue, Cricket, Sundew, Snowfall, and Luna face a threat that controls minds.
  • The prophecy points toward freedom for HiveWings, SilkWings, LeafWings, and Pyrrhia.

Warriors Series

Open Warriors Family Tree (large image)

Warrior Cat Fun Facts!

There are 5 main clans: ThunderClan, RiverClan, WindClan, ShadowClan, and SkyClan!
StarClan is where warrior ancestors watch over the living cats!
Medicine cats use herbs to heal and can speak with StarClan!
Warriors have a code of honor they must follow!
There are 8 amazing series with over 80 books to explore!
New series are still being written - the adventure continues!

Prophecy: Fire Alone

  • StarClan hints that one cat with fire-colored fur can save ThunderClan.
  • Rusty becomes Firepaw, then Fireheart, and finally Firestar.
  • The prophecy is about bravery, loyalty, and choosing Clan over comfort.

Prophecy: The New Journey

  • Chosen cats from each Clan are sent on a dangerous quest.
  • They learn the forest is no longer safe and the Clans must find a new home.
  • The prophecy teaches that old enemies sometimes have to travel together.

Prophecy: Midnight

  • StarClan sends Brambleclaw, Squirrelpaw, Crowpaw, Feathertail, Stormfur, and Tawnypelt far from the forest.
  • The journey leads them to the sun-drown-place and a warning about Twolegs.
  • This prophecy begins the Clans' move toward the lake territories.

Prophecy: Silver Cat

  • A silver cat is foretold to save the mountain Tribe from Sharptooth.
  • Feathertail becomes the cat who fulfills it.
  • The prophecy shows that courage can come with sacrifice.

Prophecy: Power of Three

  • Three kin of Firestar's kin are said to hold unusual power.
  • Jayfeather, Lionblaze, and Dovewing discover gifts that shape the Clans' future.
  • The prophecy grows into a battle between the living Clans and the Dark Forest.

Prophecy: The Fourth Cat

  • The Three are not complete until another cat joins them.
  • Dovewing's power becomes important to the Clans' survival.
  • This prophecy connects Power of Three with Omen of the Stars.

Prophecy: The Dark Forest

  • Dead warriors train living cats for a battle against StarClan.
  • The Clans must decide who they trust when old enemies return.
  • The prophecy builds toward the Great Battle in The Last Hope.

Prophecy: The Blazing Star

  • In the ancient past, the first Clan cats follow signs toward a new future.
  • A blazing star becomes a sign of change, healing, and the birth of the Clans.
  • This prophecy belongs to Dawn of the Clans.

Prophecy: Shadows and Stars

  • Later messages warn of broken laws, silent ancestors, and dangerous impostors.
  • Alderheart, Twigbranch, Violetshine, Shadowsight, Rootspring, and Bristlefrost face hard choices.
  • These prophecies ask what makes a true warrior when StarClan feels far away.

Prophecy: Embrace What You Find

  • Alderheart receives a message that sends him beyond ThunderClan's borders.
  • The quest leads to SkyClan and changes the shape of the lake Clans.
  • This prophecy begins A Vision of Shadows.

Prophecy: The Broken Code

  • The warrior code, StarClan, and the living Clans all come under pressure.
  • Shadowsight receives strange visions while an impostor threatens ThunderClan.
  • The prophecy asks whether the Clans can fix what has been broken.

Prophecy: A Starless Clan

  • RiverClan loses its leader and struggles without clear guidance.
  • Frostpaw's messages become part of a mystery about truth and trust.
  • The prophecy follows the Clans as they question old rules and new leaders.

Meet the Warrior Heroes!

Firestar

Once a house cat named Rusty, he became the greatest leader ThunderClan ever knew!

Graystripe

Firestar's best friend, a loyal gray tom who loves adventure and his friends!

Sandstorm

A fierce and independent she-cat who became Firestar's mate and a brave warrior!

Bluestar

The wise ThunderClan leader who first saw Rusty's brave heart.

Yellowfang

A sharp-tongued medicine cat with a huge, loyal heart.

Ravenpaw

A nervous apprentice who showed real courage when the Clan needed truth.

Cinderpelt

A joyful apprentice who became a caring and clever medicine cat.

Spottedleaf

A gentle medicine cat whose dreams and warnings echoed from StarClan.

Tigerstar

A powerful warrior whose ambition made him one of the darkest threats.

Bramblestar

A brave ThunderClan tom who fought to choose his own path.

Squirrelflight

Bold, stubborn, and fiercely loyal to the cats she loves.

Leafpool

A thoughtful medicine cat whose choices changed ThunderClan forever.

Jayfeather

A grumpy, brilliant medicine cat with powers far beyond ordinary sight.

Lionblaze

A fearless fighter with strength that helped shape the Clans' future.

Hollyleaf

A serious ThunderClan warrior who cared deeply about the warrior code.

Dovewing

A kind cat with extraordinary senses and a very important destiny.

Ivypool

A daring spy who risked everything to protect the Clans.

Alderheart

A gentle medicine cat who helped guide a new generation.

Twigbranch

A young cat who searched for where she truly belonged.

Violetshine

A brave SkyClan cat who faced hard choices with courage.

Shadowsight

A ShadowClan medicine cat tangled in mysterious visions.

Rootspring

A SkyClan warrior with a strange connection to spirits.

Bristlefrost

A loyal ThunderClan warrior remembered for her courage and love.

Frostpaw

A RiverClan apprentice pulled into a mystery about her Clan's future.

Nightheart

A ThunderClan tom trying to step out of Firestar's long shadow.

Sunbeam

A thoughtful ShadowClan warrior learning what loyalty means to her.

Moonpaw

A quiet apprentice with steady paws and a curiosity that uncovers hidden paths.

Harry Potter Series

Welcome to Hogwarts

Explore the books, houses, characters, spells, and magical objects from the wizarding world.

Harry Potter Fun Facts!

Hogwarts students are sorted into four houses: Gryffindor, Slytherin, Ravenclaw, and Hufflepuff.
The story follows Harry from his first year at Hogwarts through the final battle against Voldemort.
Quidditch is a wizard sport played on broomsticks with four balls and seven players on each team.
The Marauder's Map shows secret passages and moving people inside Hogwarts.

鬼滅の刃　柱紹介

柱とは？

柱（はしら） は、鬼殺隊の中でもとくに高い実力をもつ最強クラスの剣士たちです。
それぞれが自分だけの 呼吸 をきわめ、強い信念を胸に人々を守って戦います。
下のカードをクリックすると、大きな紹介カードが開きます。

九人の柱
呼吸
鬼殺隊
クリックで大きく表示
この版は、まず 鬼滅の刃ページの構造とクリック動作を正しく戻す ために作り直した版です。
実際の柱画像を安定して入れるには、画像ファイルそのものが必要です。
水柱
くわしく見る
冨岡 義勇
とみおか ぎゆう
水の呼吸
寡黙で冷静。感情をあまり表に出さないけれど、心の奥には強いやさしさを持っています。静かな剣筋と落ち着いた判断が印象的な柱です。
蟲柱
くわしく見る
胡蝶 しのぶ
こちょう しのぶ
蟲の呼吸
やわらかな笑顔が印象的ですが、その内側には強い意志を秘めています。小柄で素早く、毒を使った独自の戦い方で鬼に立ち向かいます。
炎柱
くわしく見る
煉獄 杏寿郎
れんごく きょうじゅろう
炎の呼吸
まっすぐで豪快、そして誰よりも熱い心を持つ柱。明るい言葉と力強い姿で、仲間にも見る人にも強い勇気を与えてくれます。
音柱
くわしく見る
宇髄 天元
うずい てんげん
音の呼吸
派手を愛する華やかな柱。自信たっぷりで迫力もありますが、仲間思いで責任感も強い人物です。戦い方までとてもきらびやかです。
恋柱
くわしく見る
甘露寺 蜜璃
かんろじ みつり
恋の呼吸
明るくてやさしく、感情表現がとても豊か。見た目のかわいらしさとは反対に、とてつもない力としなやかな動きをあわせ持つ柱です。
霞柱
くわしく見る
時透 無一郎
ときとう むいちろう
霞の呼吸
ふわりとしてつかみどころがない雰囲気ですが、剣の才能はずばぬけています。静かな空気の中で、一瞬にして相手を圧倒する強さがあります。
蛇柱
くわしく見る
伊黒 小芭内
いぐろ おばない
蛇の呼吸
厳しくまじめで、鋭い視線が印象的。白蛇の鏑丸とともに戦い、くねるような独特の剣技で敵を追いつめます。内面はとても一途です。
風柱
くわしく見る
不死川 実弥
しなずがわ さねみ
風の呼吸
荒々しく激しい気迫を放つ柱。近寄りがたい印象がありますが、人を守る思いはとても強く、命がけで戦い続ける熱い人物です。
岩柱
くわしく見る
悲鳴嶼 行冥
ひめじま ぎょうめい
岩の呼吸
大きな体と圧倒的な存在感を持つ、鬼殺隊最強の柱のひとり。厳かで静かな雰囲気の中に、深い慈しみと信仰心をたたえています。
